What the product is for, in a person's words.

specs.title: demo-product/alpha Specification
specs.purpose: Alpha does one thing, and this fixture is what proves the reader sees it.

requirements.name: The thing happens once
requirements.text: The system SHALL do the thing exactly once and SHALL refuse a second ask.

scenarios.name: The thing happens
scenarios.text:
**Serves:** alpha-US-01 - Reader follows the thing end to end

- **WHEN** a reader asks for the thing
- **THEN** the thing happens
scenarios.servesProse: Reader follows the thing end to end

scenarios.name: The thing is refused a second time
scenarios.text:
**Serves:** alpha-US-01 - Reader follows the thing end to end

- **GIVEN** the thing already happened
- **WHEN** a reader asks again
- **THEN** nothing happens and the record is unchanged
scenarios.servesProse: Reader follows the thing end to end

requirements.name: The thing is written down
requirements.text: The system SHALL record the thing.

scenarios.name: A scenario that predates permanent ids
scenarios.text:
- **WHEN** a spec omits the scenario id
- **THEN** the reader still carries the scenario, without one

specs.featureSet:
- Doing the thing
  - Once only: the thing happens exactly once
  - Written down: the thing leaves a record

journeys.title: Reader follows the thing end to end
journeys.text:
**As a** reader,
**I want** the thing to happen once and leave a record,
**so that** I can tell whether it already happened.

testCases.title: Reader asks for the thing and it happens
Reader asks a second time and is refused

specs.title: demo-topic Specification
specs.purpose:
A cross-cutting topic: a directory holding `spec.md` directly, so the reader
files it under topics rather than products.

requirements.name: Every surface reads the topic the same way
requirements.text: Every surface SHALL read the topic through one module.

scenarios.name: One module answers
scenarios.text:
- **WHEN** a surface reads the topic
- **THEN** it goes through the one module

changes.title: Add the thing
changes.why: Nothing does the thing yet, so nobody can tell whether it happened.

tasks.text: 1.3 A nested checkbox still counts toward this group.

requirements.name: The thing is watched
requirements.text:
### Requirement: The thing is watched

The system SHALL let a reader watch the thing.

#### Scenario: alpha-SC-03 - A reader watches the thing

- **WHEN** a reader watches the thing
- **THEN** the watch is recorded

requirements.name: The thing happens once
requirements.text:
### Requirement: The thing happens once

The system SHALL do the thing exactly once, and SHALL say so.

#### Scenario: alpha-SC-01 - The thing happens

- **WHEN** a reader asks for the thing
- **THEN** the thing happens and the system says so

changes.author: tester
followOns: **The thing happens twice**, for the collectors who asked for a second one the same day.
A record anyone can read back.
